steps.text: 1. On the tour detail page, the Tourist chooses the languages and taps "Download (n languages)".
2. The system checks the network connection. E1.

exceptions.text: E1. No network → "A network connection (Wi-Fi or mobile data) is needed to download the tour".

steps.text: 3. The system gets the file list of the tour package for each language (manifest). E2, E7.

exceptions.text: E2. The tour is no longer public (404) or the language has no translation (400) → error, no download.
E7. A paid tour (UC#25) the Tourist has not bought → a "Buy the tour to download" box replaces the download section; calling the manifest directly: 401 (not signed in) or 402 (not bought).

steps.text: 4. The system estimates the size of the files and compares it with the free space on the device. E3.

exceptions.text: E3. Not enough space → "Not enough storage on the device."

steps.text: 5. The system downloads 3 files at a time into browser storage (IndexedDB) and shows the real progress. A1, E4, E5.

exceptions.text: E4. Network lost midway → "Network connection lost. The downloaded part has been kept."
E5. A file fails → the package is in an error state; the "Retry" button downloads the missing files again.

steps.text: 6. When done, the system marks the package ready, asks for persistent storage and records a download for the statistics (UC#17).
7. The system shows the storage used and an "Open offline version" button.
8. The Tourist opens Account → Downloaded tours. A2, A3, A4.
9. The system lists the downloaded tours, compares versions with the server when online and adds the label "New version available" or "Tour is no longer public". E6.

exceptions.text: E6. No tours yet → empty list; the browser blocks IndexedDB → the offline feature is reported as unavailable.

steps: A1. Pause / resume / cancel the download: the downloaded part is kept; an interrupted package shows "Interrupted" and resumes from the missing files.
A2. Delete a language or the whole tour: the system deletes the files that belong only to that part and reports the real amount of space freed.
A3. Listen offline: open the offline player (/offline/:tourId/play); GPS and audio run entirely from the downloaded data (UC#04).
A4. Update to a new version: download the package again for the latest tour version and replace the old one when done.
